# Insight UI

> A reusable Django component library by Alpin Insight Solutions: production-ready UI building blocks implemented as Django template tags with typed configuration dataclasses, styled with Tailwind CSS, and enhanced with HTMX. WCAG 2.2 AA is the accessibility target.

The PyPI package is `insight-ui`. Install it with `uv add insight-ui` or `pip install insight-ui` (Python 3.12 or later, Django 5.2 to 6.x). Add `insight_ui` to `INSTALLED_APPS` and include the `insight_ui.context_processors.insight_ui_context` context processor. Extend `insight_ui/base.html` and load the `insight_tags` library to use components such as `{% button %}`, `{% card %}`, and `{% alert %}`.

Insight UI is accessibility-focused, RTL and i18n ready, and includes light and dark themes. WCAG 2.2 AA is a design target, not a verified package-wide conformance claim; conformance must be assessed for complete pages and processes in the consuming application. No separate JavaScript framework is required.

Documentation website: <https://insight-ui.com>
Company website: <https://alpininsight.com>
License: AGPL-3.0. A commercial license is described in `COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md`.

## Documentation

- [Insight UI documentation](https://insight-ui.com/): live documentation and component catalog
- [Installation](https://insight-ui.com/docs/installation): install the package and add it to a Django project
- [Base template](https://insight-ui.com/docs/base_template): `insight_ui/base.html` page structure and blocks
- [Component configs](https://insight-ui.com/docs/configs): typed configuration dataclasses for the component catalog
- [Customization](https://insight-ui.com/docs/customization): design tokens, theming, and template overrides
- [README](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/README.md): features, quick start, and package scope
- [Getting started](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/getting-started.md): installation and configuration, including static assets
- [Components guide](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/components.md): template tag API and patterns
- [Public Config contract](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/component-config-contract.md): Config and tag parity for consumers and extensions
- [Design system](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/design-system.md): tokens, theming, and customization
- [Static assets](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/static-assets.md): staticfiles and CDN configuration
- [Accessibility](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/accessibility.md): WCAG scope, testing, and limitations
- [Internationalization](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/i18n.md): i18n and RTL support
- [Migrating to 2.0](https://github.com/alpininsight/insight-ui/blob/develop/docs/migration-2.0.md): breaking changes from v1.15.1
